verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents a Registrar API for searching, checking, registering, and managing domains, and publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, so the core domain lifecycle appears scriptable. However, most documented flows (transfers, expiration review, auto-renew status, WHOIS edits, one-click DNSSEC) are described only as dashboard steps, and nothing confirms the API matches the UI. Missing for 10: evidence that transfers, auto-renew toggling, WHOIS contact edits, DNSSEC activation and lock/unlock are exposed via API; an explicit API/UI parity statement; independent hands-on corroboration.
